The Knowledge Project Podcast

Bill Ackman is the founder and CEO of Pershing Square Capital Management, one of the most closely watched investment firms in the world.

Who Actually Profits From AI?

Netflix: Why He Changed His Mind

01:00:02

Berkshire’s Most Overlooked Advantage

In this conversation, he breaks down the difference between real innovation and hype, how he invests, and his plan to build a modern-day Berkshire Hathaway.

But more importantly, Bill shows another side of himself when he opens up about his daughter Lucy’s sudden brain hemorrhage, the hours before surgery, and her ongoing recovery. He describes running his business from a hospital room and the institute he and his wife are building to help others facing similar challenges.
